description: OneLink view-through impression URLs on impressions.onelink.me, whose template ID rides in the path and whose media source rides as pid.

params.name: template_id
params.description: It is the OneLink template ID, and it travels in the path after impressions.onelink.me. AppsFlyer documents impression URLs as that host plus the template ID from the long URL.
params.fix_hint: Copy the template ID from the OneLink long URL so the path is /{template ID}.

params.name: pid
params.description: It is the media source. AppsFlyer documents pid as the value under which the impression is reported.
params.fix_hint: Set pid to the media source name from the OneLink.
